decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound builds directly on the firm's woodworking and assembly competence, so management can interpret its sales and refine the models without new outside knowledge.
The one-tier arched pyramid is a core Erzgebirge-style product fully within the firm's craft knowledge, and seasonal pyramids remain a stable part of its range.

The firm presents the electronic music box line as a flagship, and by now it has likely built enough experience with the sourced mechanism to keep developing it, even though the electronics lie outside its core knowledge.

This peripheral accessory is distant from the firm's competence and was only marginally presented, but it supports the flagship music box line, so it stays for now, though it remains at real risk of pruning.
The Dresden-themed pyramid extends the firm's established pyramid craftsmanship and regional design knowledge, which makes it a low-risk continuation.
